name: flutter-crew
description: Flutter delivery workflows, Copilot agents and portable evidence-based quality gates for Firebase and Supabase.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');for(const dir of ['bin','.agents/runtime','scripts'])for(const file of fs.readdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'))){const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',dir+'/'+file],{stdio:'inherit'});if(result.status!==0)process.exit(1);}"
